en: Colorized historic postcard view of the main entrance gate to a military barracks complex. The scene shows a large arched gateway with the inscription "Jäger-Kaserne" above it, flanked by multi‑story barracks buildings with red-tiled roofs and many windows. A uniformed guard stands in front of the gate, and iron railings enclose the entrance. The sky is softly tinted blue and pink, typical of early 20th‑century color postcards. The caption at the top identifies the location in red script.
